status: preregistered development diagnostic; not a held-out expert benchmark
annotation: Required papers selected from actual inspected source abstracts/snippets before running methods. Alternative evidence can also be valid; coverage is a diagnostic only.

questions.question: 为什么检索增强有时会降低问答准确率？请结合无关上下文鲁棒性研究与 Corrective RAG，解释问题机制、两类修正办法及各自的限制，不要把相关性当成已证明的因果性。

criteria.description: Discuss irrelevant evidence and possible cascading errors without claiming every added passage harms accuracy.
Describe NLI filtering and its relevant-passage discard tradeoff, or training with mixed relevant/irrelevant contexts.
Describe CRAG quality evaluation and corrective retrieval/refinement based on supplied evidence.
Preserve study conditions or acknowledge missing comparability details.

questions.question: Self-RAG 与 Corrective RAG 如何分别处理检索与生成的可靠性？请解释两者的机制区别和互补性，给出跨论文依据，并明确证据不支持的结论。

criteria.description: Explain adaptive retrieval and reflection tokens in Self-RAG.
Explain CRAG retrieval evaluation, confidence-guided actions and refinement.
Discuss possible complementarity without inventing additive experimental gains.
Separate reported mechanisms from unverified universal ranking or deployment recommendation.

questions.question: 根据这些文献，能否认定过滤或压缩检索内容总能提升 RAG，并且 CRAG 一定优于 Self-RAG？请分别说明支持证据、反例或代价，以及还缺少哪些比较条件。

criteria.description: Reject universal improvement as unestablished by provided evidence.
Identify risk of discarding relevant passages when filtering.
Do not assert a supported universal CRAG-over-Self-RAG ranking.
Identify missing matched models, tasks, datasets or evaluation conditions.
